* 基本

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
(require 'subr-x)
(defun org-greet (who)
  "WHO に挨拶する。"
  (message "hello %s" who))

* 例

#+BEGIN_SRC elisp :tangle no
(defvar org-counter 0)
(defun org-bump () (setq org-counter (1+ org-counter)) (org-greet "x"))
#+END_SRC
